# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.2 — Settings & graphics card choice

## ✨ What's new

### ⚙️ New Settings panel
Open it from the sidebar (⚙ **Settings**) or with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>,</kbd>.
- **AI graphics card** — let the app choose (*Auto*) or pick the card that runs AI Enhance (dedicated or integrated). A **Test** button checks it in one second.
- **Video encoder** — *Auto*, **NVIDIA NVENC**, **Intel Quick Sync**, **AMD AMF** or **CPU only**. Encoders your PC doesn't have are shown as *not detected*; the sidebar badge follows your choice.
- **Vulkan version** — see at a glance which Vulkan your driver provides (the API used by the AI engines).
- **Keep the PC awake while working** — no more sleep mode in the middle of a long export, AI job or download (on by default).
- **Rescan hardware** — after a driver update or plugging in an external GPU.

### 🩺 Clear messages when the AI can't run
- If your graphics card can't run the AI, **AI Enhance tells you why** right away — no Vulkan driver, no compatible card, driver too old, card unplugged — with a **Get the driver** button for your GPU (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel).
- The card is checked **before** a job starts, so an error shows up immediately instead of after minutes of work.
- Clearer errors during a job: *not enough graphics memory*, *the graphics driver stopped responding*…
- A card you picked that disappears (external GPU unplugged…) switches back to **Auto** automatically.

### 🧹 Housekeeping
- Temporary AI files left behind by a crash or a forced shutdown are cleaned up on the next start.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
